open_points.point: Result 1 requires the boundary sentence to say judgement stops at the interpreters and shells the header lists, but the classifier also judges programs outside that list: prefix commands (`sudo`, `doas`, `command`, `builtin`, `exec`, `env`, `nice`, `nohup`, `time`, `timeout`, `stdbuf`, `busybox`, `xargs`) and the script-taking builtins `find -exec|-execdir|-ok|-okdir`, `eval`, `trap`, `alias`, `hash -p`, `source`/`.` and `omp sh|bash|zsh -c`. The contract neither states whether the sentence must enumerate these nor how to word the boundary without denying them.
